summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Smart Project Builder feature. All backend tests (14/14 passed - 100%) and frontend UI tests passed. The Smart Project Builder with 4-step workflow, AI code generation via Gemini 3 Flash, ZIP download, project versioning, and Admin LLM configuration are all working correctly.
passed_tests: Smart Project Builder loads with 4-step workflow (Describe → Configure → Hardware → Software)
Step 1: Project Name and Description form works correctly
Step 2: Hardware selection shows 5 boards with details (SiFive HiFive1, Kendryte K210, ESP32-C3, StarFive VisionFive 2, Test Board)
Step 3: Software/Middleware selection works - shows compatible middleware and software components
Step 4: Peripherals selection and Generate button work
Project generation with LLM creates downloadable project (Version 1 • 11 files)
Download ZIP button appears after successful generation
My Projects page shows generated projects with version history
Download Latest button works on My Projects page
Admin LLM Configuration page loads correctly
Admin can view current LLM settings (Provider: Gemini, Model: gemini-3-flash-preview)
Admin can select from 3 providers: Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic
Admin can choose between Emergent LLM Key and Custom API Key
Save Configuration button available for admin
Backend: Hardware endpoint returns 5 boards
Backend: Middleware endpoint returns 5 items
Backend: Software components endpoint returns items
Backend: Compatible middleware filtering works
Backend: Compatible software filtering by hardware_id works
Backend: Project generation endpoint creates project with version
Backend: Projects list endpoint returns user's projects
Backend: Project download endpoint returns ZIP file
Backend: LLM providers endpoint returns 3 providers with models
Backend: Admin LLM settings GET/PUT endpoints work
Backend: LLM settings requires admin authentication
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed duplicate download endpoint definition in server.py - removed placeholder endpoint at line 1459 that was overriding the proper implementation at line 1771
seed_data_creation: Test projects created during testing: 'test', 'Test IoT Sensor Project'
